name: Carrot Stalk
part_1: A petition has been submitted for the hunting of Carrot (Rank VII). The petitioner is Zammadria in the Nalbina aerodrome.
part_2: Hunt accepted. Zammadria's pet, Carrot, has run away! It has since become feral and dangerous, attacking travelers. Carrot can be found in the Salikawood, but beware: it scares easily, and killing monsters nearby is sure to send it into hiding.
part_3: Carrot defeated! Report to Zammadria in the aerodrome in Nalbina.
part_4: Hunt reported. Zammadria had been raising Carrot to spite her husband, always concerned with keeping up appearances. She realizes now the error of her ways.
explanation: Carrot Stalk, petitioned by Zammadria (Nalbina Fortress); the record shows its 4 parts from progress 10, 20, 30, 50, and the row is marked done from progress 30

name: Battle on the Big Bridge
part_1: A petition has been submitted for the hunting of the Ancient Man of Mystery (Rank VII). The petitioner is Montblanc in the clan hall in Rabanastre.
part_2: Hunt accepted. Montblanc tells you that an individual has wagered his sword in combat with the Ancient Man of Mystery and lost. This mysterious adversary is to be found on a bridge somewhere in the Lhusu Mines.
part_3: Gave chase to Gilgamesh, yet he escaped. You must find out where he hides and confront him once again!
part_4: Gilgamesh defeated in the depths of the Lhusu Mines. Report to Montblanc in the clan hall.
part_5: Hunt reported. But just who was Gilgamesh, and why did he yearn so for a sword? No wonder they call him the Ancient Man of Mystery!
explanation: Battle on the Big Bridge, petitioned by Montblanc (Rabanastre); the record shows its 5 parts from progress 10, 30, 50, 100, 130, and the row is marked done from progress 100

name: A Dark Rumor
part_1: A petition has been submitted for the hunting of Belito (Rank V). The petitioner is Montblanc in the clan hall in Rabanastre.
part_2: Hunt accepted. Montblanc tells you of rumors of a creature called "Belito" said to be creating sandstorms with its wings upon the Nam-Yensa Sandsea. Information is sparse, however, and Montblanc wants you to investigate further.
part_3: Encountered the headhunter Ba'Gamnan and his crew while searching for Belito. In an attempt to nab Balthier, Ba'Gamnan had been lurking near the places where marks were spotted, attacking whatever hunters arrived when Balthier failed to appear. Defeated Ba'Gamnan, with the help of Monid, who was searching for this "Hunter Stalker." Ba'Gamnan sank beneath the sandy Yensan waves, never to return...
part_4: According to Monid, the Clan had been hoping to catch the Hunter Stalker, Ba'Gamnan, all along. "Belito" was nothing more than a ruse to draw Ba'Gamnan out into the open. Reward received from Monid.
explanation: A Dark Rumor, petitioned by Montblanc (Rabanastre); the record shows its 4 parts from progress 10, 30, 70, 100, and the row is marked done from progress 70

name: Truth Shrouded in Mist
part_1: A petition has been submitted for the hunting of the Behemoth King (Rank VII). The petitioner is Koqmihn in Dalan's house in Rabanastre.
part_2: Hunt accepted. Koqmihn wants you to discover what truth lies behind the legend of the Behemoth King said to live on a snowy plain deep within the Feywood. The best way to lure out the Behemoth King is by killing its "subjects." Defeat all the monsters in the area and the King is sure to emerge.
part_3: Behemoth King defeated. Report to Koqmihn in Dalan's house in Rabanastre.
part_4: Hunt reported. Koqmihn rejoiced to hear the legend was true. His friend's dying wish had been to find out once and for all. Koqmihn then told you the continuation of the legend.
part_5: Following the legend's trail, you investigated the dragon's head on Mt Bur-Omisace and were rewarded for your curiosity.
explanation: Truth Shrouded in Mist, petitioned by Koqmihn (Rabanastre); the record shows its 5 parts from progress 10, 30, 70, 100, 130, and the row is marked done from progress 70
